thread:
pranav: Quick sync — follow-up on the svc-token-validator postmortem. We have outstanding items across token validation tests, audit events, and secrets rotation. Postmortem here: https://confluence.redwood/postmortems/svc-token-validator-2409. Please state ownership and ETA.

anya: @pranav I can own the token validation test harness and add unit+integration tests. Will open PR by EOD. Jira: IN-3827.

taylor: I'll take audit-log integration and retention policy updates. Plan: emit structured JSON events and push to kinesis stream. ETA 2024-03-31. @pranav do we need >90d retention for any billing/legal traces?

pranav: Legal scoped it to 90d for now; escalate if compliance requires more. Also add invoice-level audit_event IDs for billing traceability.

chen: I'll own the secrets rotation checklist for the service-account keys and coordinate infra for rolling re-deploy without downtime. ETA next Tue. Draft runbook at docs/runbooks/rotate-svc-keys.md (WIP).

sec-bot: Reminder: scheduled key rotation job failed 2024-03-22 14:02 — ticket IN-3840 auto-created.

sam: I'll run the canary rollout for the patched validator and monitor token miss rates + 5xx spikes. Staging canary then prod; ETA tomorrow AM.

pranav: Verification criteria: 1) no unexplained 401s for 24h post-deploy; 2) audit events include token_validated:true/false and request_id for all auth flows; 3) rotated secrets verified absent from nodes and CI artifacts. Owners: add these checks to the Jira tickets.

anya: Created IN-3850 for test harness PR -> https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2850. Added tests for expired, malformed, and high-latency cache eviction paths.

taylor: Created IN-3851 for audit schema + kinesis wiring. Draft schema pushed: ```json
{"event":"token_check","status":"passed|failed","user_id":"...","timestamp":"...","request_id":"..."}
```

chen: Created IN-3852 runbook + rotation playbook — draft at https://confluence.redwood/rotate-keys. Need infra approval for rolling restart and a checklist for verifying no secret leakage.

pranav: I'll consolidate into a single tracker and schedule a 15m sync tomorrow 10:15am PT. If you can't make it, post status updates here before the sync.

pranav: Observed recurring pattern: validator cache eviction under bursty QPS causes token validation misses. Long-term action: evaluate auto-warm + eviction tuning and a fallback to a stateless check that verifies signature only. I'll file IN-3853 for the investigation and put preliminary perf metrics in the tracker.
